source_context.scope_note: This supplements the earlier Q fixture-only review. Its earlier HOST6-not-yet-supplied boundary is preserved as a historical observation.

driver: Append the two previously failing socket tests to HOST_TESTS
Change two diagnostic strings from four to six; boolean conditions are unchanged
launcher: r11 Git-head observation and shared-target-agreement paths

partition_and_assertions.result: All six exact names are skipped only in private_args and selected with --exact in host_args. The driver enumerates all/private/host names from the same library binary, requires private and host to be disjoint, their union to equal all tests, and host to equal the exact HOST_TESTS set.
All six host tests must be ordinary, not ignored. Their nonempty selection requires result=ok, passed=6, failed=0, ignored=0 and measured=0, with exact filtered count derived from the full inventory.

The existing private runner still uses bwrap with its private /tmp; the six-test host runner remains outside that wrapper, uses the same artifact and TMPDIR=/tmp, and remains serial. No test body or socket ownership check is changed.

Per-stage artifact identity before/after, executable runner checks, exact final stage order, exit-0 requirements and exact Rust result-to-selection equality are unchanged. A missing host stage or incorrect selected count cannot satisfy finish.

Existing debug/assertion requirement, final-source/input binding checks, clean worktree requirement, single nonblocking owner lock and finally close are unchanged by this patch. The reviewer did not execute any of them.

derivation.stages: 9 named initial stages + 20 integration stages + 4 ignored stages + release + decoder
derivation.rust_stages: 2 library partitions + 20 integration stages + 4 ignored stages

failure_relation.observed_C_errors: Both added host names are the two C tests that failed on unsafe /tmp parent ownership/permissions under the private runner.
failure_relation.interpretation: The change assigns those tests to the already existing host-environment partition and requires them to execute there; it does not waive their assertions.
failure_relation.not_proved_here: Whether the final bound Q/r11 execution passes these cases or the full gate. C failure evidence remains unchanged.

unbound_boundary.placeholders_remain: The prepared launcher retains UNBOUND_FINAL_OBSERVATIONS / UNBOUND_COORDINATION_RECEIPT and final-source placeholders; its early shape checks reject unbound inputs.
